_meta.description: Credit card points valuations in cents per point (cpp). Two values per currency: 'cashback' (redemption via statement credit or cash) and 'transfer' (best value via transfer partners). Sources: The Points Guy March 2026, Upgraded Points March 2026, NerdWallet March 2026.

currencies.name: Chase Ultimate Rewards
currencies.notes: Transfer value per TPG March 2026. Cash value = 1¢ baseline; Sapphire Reserve portal = 1.5¢+ (Points Boost up to 1.75¢), Sapphire Preferred portal = 1.25¢. Transfer partners include Hyatt, United, Southwest, British Airways, Air France/KLM, Singapore, Marriott.

currencies.name: American Express Membership Rewards
currencies.notes: Transfer value per TPG March 2026. Cash/statement credit value is only 0.6¢ — a poor redemption. Best value via airline transfers (ANA, Air Canada, Air France/KLM, Delta, etc.). Transfer partners include 20+ airlines and hotels.

currencies.name: Citi ThankYou Rewards
currencies.notes: Transfer value per TPG March 2026. Citi added American AAdvantage as a transfer partner in July 2025 — a significant addition. Most transfers happen instantly.

currencies.name: Capital One Miles
currencies.notes: Transfer value per TPG March 2026. Can also be redeemed at 1¢ toward travel purchases or statement credits. Transfer partners include Turkish Airlines (great for US-Europe business class), Air France/KLM, Avianca, and more.

currencies.name: Bilt Rewards Points
currencies.notes: #1 ranked currency per TPG March 2026 at 2.2¢ transfer value. Unique: points can be redeemed toward rent, mortgage down payments, and student loans. Bilt Cash alternative earns 4% back on everyday spending.

currencies.name: Navy Federal Rewards Points
currencies.notes: Points are worth a flat 1¢ per point regardless of redemption method. No airline or hotel transfer partners — purely cash-equivalent value. 1,000 points = $10.

currencies.name: Wells Fargo Rewards
currencies.notes: Active Cash earns straight 2% cash back (not points). Autograph earns transferable points; transfer to airline/hotel partners via Wells Fargo. Transfer value estimated at 1.5¢ based on partner availability. Active Cash is purely cash back at 1¢/dollar of reward.

currencies.name: American Express Reward Dollars
currencies.notes: Amex Blue Cash cards earn Reward Dollars redeemable as statement credits at 1¢ per dollar. No transfer partners — purely cash-back value.

currencies.name: Atmos Rewards Points
currencies.notes: Atmos Rewards points transfer to Alaska Mileage Plan (a oneworld member) and Hawaiian Airlines HawaiianMiles. Transfer value estimated at 1.8¢ based on Alaska Mileage Plan partner redemption sweet spots (e.g., Cathay Pacific, Japan Airlines, American AAdvantage). TPG Best New Card for 2026.
